I’ve directed MDTA to conduct a new procurement and to deliver the best deal for taxpayers while ensuring that the project is delivered with the highest standards.

238 years ago, Maryland became the 7th state to ratify the U.S. Constitution.

Democracy has never been a guarantee. Every generation has had to fight to protect and strengthen it – and that remains true today.

Clayton Bump is a 100-year-old World War II Navy veteran who lives at Charlotte Hall Veterans Home, a now 4 Star facility.

For his service, he was awarded the American Theater Medal, the European Theater Medal, the Asiatic-Pacific Medal, the Victory Medal, and the Presidential Unit Citation. His own brother made the ultimate sacrifice in World War II.

When people complain about something being hard, Clayton tells them, "That might be hard, but try being 100."

Thank you to the Secret Service and law enforcement for their swift response at tonight’s White House Correspondents’ Dinner. I’m grateful everyone is reported to be safe and that the suspected shooter is in custody.

We will never stop fighting for those who put everything on the line for our freedom.

Effective immediately, Maryland state government employees are BANNED from using inside information from their jobs to make money on prediction markets.

Government officials should never be able to participate in prediction markets. It creates a conflict of interest for officials and encourages them to work for the markets and not their constituents.

My executive order makes sure no one in my administration will be able to line their own pockets through predictive markets.

The federal reclassification of medical marijuana is a step in the right direction.

Two years ago, I took historic action, pardoning over 175,000 cannabis possession convictions. It’s an action that helped Marylanders who were impacted by outdated laws.

I know from firsthand experience that reforms like these – when done in partnership – actually help improve people’s lives, and we in Maryland are going to keep delivering wins that help people.

🏢  In Leonardtown, I joined local leaders for a walking tour of their historic downtown, where we’ve invested nearly $1 million to support local revitalization.

But I promised to fight for ALL Marylanders, and that's exactly what we did this session. Here's what we got done. ⬇️

The beautiful environment we have – it's our job to protect it, just like we’d do with any heirloom.

Protect it. Care for it. And hopefully pass on something just as beautiful as the way that you found it.

Hitting our land conservation goal SIX years early, planting five MILLION trees across the state, working in partnership to turn underdeveloped land and crumbling apartments into affordable homes near Metro and light rail stations, supporting farmers and ensuring cleaner water for our Bay. 

Every day, our administration is putting in the work to protect our land, water, and people. Happy Earth Day, Maryland.
